name: Spud (poor)
personality: The main character (Jonny, 11 Nov 2026). The one normal potato among the fighters, kept neutral on purpose: no quirk, no type. Wants an ordinary day, reacts the way the average person would, goes along with his friends. The fighters carry the quirks; he is the straight man the viewer stands in for.
voiceNote: gibberish, mid and plain (a proposal until Jonny has heard it)
notes: POOR variant (Happiness 01 'Does money make you happy?', DESIGN.md section 11.1): the same Spud (body, face, hands, voice) in a faded, dirty, frayed sweater. costume.poor: faded teal #47857e with stitch contrast x 0.7, seven dirt blots and a mud band drawn into the sweater's own map, a second patch (#9a5540, cream cross-stitches) on the front, a frayed hem (ragged edge, 22 yarn ends, a hole) from x -0.05 to the left side, 7 yarn ends on the right cuff, four skin smudges (brown-grey, 2 mm off the skin, clear of the eyes, brows and mouth). No beanie: the bare leaf carries the mood (the clip sets droop 0.6, sad curve -0.35, brow 0.5, eyes down, lean 6). The balaclava prop fits unchanged. Empty pockets are the props `pocketlining` (w 0.16, h 0.11, #fbf8f1).
